metadata.title: Dependency Transparency

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for maintaining transparency into third-party software dependencies and components.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: SBOM generation, dependency inventory, and software composition analysis technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for creating, maintaining, and analyzing software bills of materials to support supply chain risk management.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Dependency transparency mitigates ATT&CK techniques that exploit unknown or vulnerable third-party software components.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: SBOM and dependency transparency align with D3FEND software composition analysis and dependency risk identification techniques.

metadata.remarks: Dependency Transparency defines the capability to generate, maintain, and analyze software bills of materials (SBOMs) to ensure visibility into third-party and open-source components. Control realization is expressed at the capability level to support traceable and enforceable software supply chain risk management.

components.title: SBOM Generation and Maintenance
components.description: Generation and upkeep of software bills of materials for applications, services, and artifacts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Software components and dependencies are documented in software bills of materials prior to use.

components.title: Dependency Inventory and Tracking
components.description: Centralized inventory and lifecycle tracking of third-party and open-source dependencies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Dependencies are tracked and monitored to identify changes in risk posture over time.

components.title: Dependency Risk Analysis
components.description: Analysis of dependency information to identify vulnerable, deprecated, or malicious components.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Dependency information is analyzed to identify vulnerabilities and exposure to known risks.
